name: shiori-site
description: Shiori public website (https://www.windchant.online), statically generated with Astro.

scripts.test: node --env-file=tests/fixtures/changelog.env node_modules/astro/bin/astro.mjs build && node --env-file=tests/fixtures/changelog.env --env-file=tests/fixtures/site-verification.env node_modules/astro/bin/astro.mjs build --mode drafts --outDir dist-drafts && tsx --test "tests/**/*.test.ts"

//dependencies: Ranges shared with apps/desktop (react, tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer, @phosphor-icons/react, typescript) stay identical to it so pnpm resolves both to one store entry: the site compiles the desktop's styles.css with the desktop's Tailwind config (see tailwind.config.ts). Site-only packages are pinned. satteri is the Markdown engine Astro itself runs (the version @astrojs/markdown-satteri pins); lib/changelog.ts renders the release notes with it. sharp is the image service Astro runs for getImage (the posts' 1200×630 share pictures, lib/shareImage.ts): Astro lists it only as an optional dependency, which pnpm does not make resolvable from the site's build, so the site names it itself, at the version apps/site-video pins.
//test: The test builds read the changelog from tests/fixtures/releases.json (tests/fixtures/changelog.env), not the GitHub API: offline and on known releases. `build` (Vercel) always fetches the real releases. The drafts-mode test build also reads tests/fixtures/site-verification.env, so the search engines' verification tags are checked both set (dist-drafts/) and unset (dist/).
